legacy.interpretation: All 41 phases decoded and visually inspected: reveal/highlight of a fixed view, not an operating sequence. Actual profile roles map to AC04.VID; surface descriptors shadow/body. Shared ACS2 construction remains separate; no AC-named _MA family is present.

concept_attempts.feedback: Retains the asymmetrical three-vessel cluster, coral caps, small left vessel, bulb-headed right member, red four-lobed circular insert and blue-gray filter fields. Accepted as an interpreted detailing guide. The red insert follows observed pixels; its mechanical meaning is not established and it is not treated as proof of a medical function. Connector geometry, hidden pockets and joint wear are authored interpretations.

technical_feedback: A plain join of contacting frame boxes failed welded closed-topology preflight. Replaced it by actual Boolean union, with measured small-surface cleanup rather than weakening the gate.

New wet-joint colour edits initially did not replace the older packed PNG. The real loaded-material check rejected that candidate. Explicit unpack/edit/update/save/repack fixed the native and imported material; their pixels now agree.

glb_feedback.observation: Real initial imported front/front-quarter/rear views preserved vessel hierarchy and panels, but the blue feed between the hood and right vessel was overexposed relative to legacy/concept.
glb_feedback.action: Routed the feed farther inside the casing while keeping real connected geometry; reduced its visible prominence. Consolidated only static same-material fittings, with actual closed unions.

glb_feedback.observation: Final real imports retain the coral-dominant near-square cluster, restrained brass, three amber pod lights and two recessed filter fields. Actual material pixels include the authored wet-joint patina; casting slivers are absent after measured cleanup.
glb_feedback.action: Accept for integration review with explicit static-state and scale limits. No hidden original mechanical design, exact recovered camera or numerical legacy-fidelity percentage is asserted.

review: Legacy-led static water-filtration remaster ready for integration review; final user artistic acceptance, game state/scale and Android frame-time certification remain separate.
